name: St Aidan and St Oswald, Royton

boundary.description: From the point where Rochdale – Oldham boundary crosses Thornham Lane, N and then E along that boundary to the junction of Thornham Lane and Castleton Road. Then by a straight line to the footpath and S to and along Narrow Gate Brow, Fir Lane to its junction with Grasmere Road. Then by a bee-line SE to the High Barn Road, SW along Shaw Road, Turfland Avenue, Turfland Avenue to the end of the road. Then by a bee-line to the junction of Salmon Fields and Leonard Way and by a straight line along the footpath to Higgshaw Lane. Then by a bee-line across Oldham Edge to the junction of Godson Street and Crompton Street, W along Crompton Street, Rochdale Road, Featherstall Road North (A6048), Chadderton Way and A627 (M) Motorway. Then by a bee-line to Cinder Hill Lane past Woodside Farm and N along Cinder Hill Lane to and along the Rochdale – Oldham District boundary to the point where it crosses Thornham Lane.
